module: Flowgraph node "Set UI Race Checkpoints" (category repeat_instant, author BeamNG, duration): updates the checkpoints UI app. Inputs: "cur" (nil = clears), "max". Sends 'WayPointChange' {current, count} and a "checkpoint" entry (text "cur / max") in ui_apps_genericMissionData (category raceCheckpoints, order 100); clears with 'WayPointReset'.
notes: If max is nil, the concatenation of the "cur / max" text causes an error.

work.desc: Sends or clears the checkpoint counter in the UI.
